lines: Game data for game build 89. Fixes the page breaking on characters with an Oathword after the new game data arrived.
Vows: a red item only offers Vow lines its own base can roll (no staff lines on wands, no other idol sizes' lines on red idols). Gear Set Sim's idol search also tries red idols with Vows.
Item window: switching the base of a magic, rare or Oathword item keeps every line; lines the new base can not roll are marked.
Mana: your minions now hold mana as in the game (Skeletons and golems 7%, Skeletal Mage and Zombie 5% for a Necromancer), never taking your last 10%. Woebringer auras now reserve their 24% each.
Vows, Curses, Sentences tab: a Woe you link to Woebringer keeps it on its card and shows the mana it reserves.
Vows, Curses, Sentences tab: cards stay in place when you click them (your bar's skills first, then A to Z), and a full bar now shows a clear red warning on the card you clicked.
Grave Call now counts in your minions' DPS while it is on your bar (its minion attack speed). Its tick box can still turn it off. Not checked in game yet.

Vows: a red item can now hold up to 11 Vows (was 6), as in the game. Each later Vow counts less, but a +3 skills line still gives +3 as the 2nd Vow, so the Vow search now tries every order and can put another line first. Gear Set Sim tries 3 Vows when its box is empty, 4 on BiS.

Vows, Curses, Sentences tab: tick a card to add it to your build DPS, click a skill on the bar to take it off, mana and DPS update as you change them. Cards show the gem's attribute need and its tooltip.
Stats panel: a new Entropy section for skills and minions.
Click the build name to change its class and level too. A loaded save character offers to save a copy as a new build instead.
Character tab and Save Creator: ring, amulet, helm, gloves, boots and belt art is centred like the weapon and body armour.
FAQ: a new "Tips for the site" section with a link to the video playlist.

Gear Set Sim and Sim by Slot: a new "Oathsworn rares" box gives each rare the search makes its Oathsworn line from the Cube (a 7th line at the best tier for its item level). On for Endgame and BiS, off for Midgame.

Optimize this item: a new "Riven lines" box lets the search use Riven lines, Vows on red items included. Vows are now picked at item level 84 (the rare they come from), so a red item below 84 can get top-tier and Riven Vows too.
New Build Planner tab: Vows, Curses, Sentences. Your skill bar with a DPS card for each Vow, Herald, Woe and Sentence, their mana cost, and Oath Unbroken and support switches.

Character tab: a Test slot sims one more skill as if it were on your bar, and skills off the bar show their DPS as your main skill. With 13 skills on the bar, "Compare a new skill" puts one next to your main skill.
Potions: the prefix, suffix, Oath and Core lists work like the item window's affix list: type to search, each line's DPS gain, and the roll weight of prefixes and suffixes (not checked in game).
War Banner now counts when it is on your skill bar (its "takes more damage" tick follows the bar like curses), and its skill card on the Character tab shows the damage it adds.
Potions: each line in the prefix, suffix, Oath and Core lists shows how much DPS it adds to your Damage tab skill, like the item window does.
Gem Levels (Skills tab): hover over (or tap) a skill or support gem to see its tooltip.

Gem Levels (Skills tab) is now a chart: when you can get gems (starting gems, the Gemwright at Rupture Level 5, the early gem gifts, Oath Gifts), each class's skill gems as icons with a class switch, and supports grouped by the level they drop from.
Character tab: each skill on the bar now shows how much damage it adds to your counted skills, as a %. The main skill has none.
Character tab: the Skills card shows the skills on your bar; a button shows the rest.
Only skills on your bar add to the sim now. A ticked skill taken off the bar stops counting until it is back.
Skills on your bar with Cast on Crit and nothing linked now always count, as they fire by themselves.
Curses follow your bar: taking a curse skill off the bar unticks its curse on the Damage tab, putting one on ticks it.
Defiant Roar: a war cry with it on your bar now counts 5 Fury charges held. Checked in game (one Fury per roar, up to 5).

New Gem Levels view in the Skills tab: when each support socket opens, what each gem level needs (hero level, attribute, mana) and each class's starting gems. Skills and supports have no unlock levels of their own. Player request.
Character tab: each support on a skill now shows its socket number.
Support Gem Simulator: says when a spell is cast by a channel's Conduit and so uses the channel's supports, with a link to switch.
Ballistas and Arrow Totems: The Long Battery now counts only the Ballistas and totems that can stand (7, or 8 with the Siege Line rune), not every "+Totem" line past that. Player report.
Checked in game: Ballistas and Arrow Totems share a limit of 7, the Siege Line rune raises it to 8, and each count past it gives 5% more damage. The DPS card note now says so.
Plan next points: no longer stops at 60 points; it can plan every point you can still get (level 100 plus Quartz, minus what you have taken).
Spell Totems and Arrow Totems now count Multiple Totems and "+N Totems" lines (they always counted one totem before). The DPS card shows how many Ballistas or totems it counts as standing.
Haemorrhage: new Configure Enemy setting "Enemy bleeding from another skill" (Auto / Yes / No). Auto works as before.
Item window: new "Optimize this item" button picks the best lines for that one item (or the best Vows on a unique, with a box for how many).
Item window: Undo (and Ctrl+Z) per item, one Add list with prefixes on top and suffixes below, and the window fits without scrolling on most screens.
New Stats column beside the Character and Passive tree views: offence, defence and enemy numbers from the sim; hover a row to see the lines behind it.
Tabs always open on their first view: Build Planner on Character, Item Simulator on Item Compare, Skill Scaling on Scaling. The page no longer reopens the last tab.
Sim by Slot keeps items that leave another worn item short of an attribute, with a note.
Best Rivenstone: Vows on uniques are no longer offered. The Forge does not let a Rivenstone work on a unique (checked in the game).
